title: ContextFrame
description: Multi-turn state passed across voice/chat searches within a session. Maintained in the client (session storage) and sent with every request.

session_id.description: Client-generated UUID, stable for the browser session.

turns.description: Ordered history of previous turns in this session, newest last.

accumulated_filters.description: Filters that persist across turns (e.g. 'five servings' stays in context for follow-up queries).
